content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I need to install [product_name] [version_no] on Windows Multipoint Server 2012. I managed to install it, but the application is not available on client devices. What should I do? Please advise. Best regards, [user_name]

Hello [user_name], To better understand your issue, could you please share a screenshot of the exact version of your operating system (using the winver command) and of [product_name] [version_no]? Additionally, can you describe the architecture you've installed and how it is configured? Best regards!
Thank you for your response. I have attached some screenshots—hope these assist. Best regards.
I was unable to upload multiple files simultaneously, so here is the second file. [user_name]
The full version of [product_name] [version_no] always requires a single license. Running it in server-client mode is not possible or permitted. Regards, [user_name]
Hello, Thank you for clarifying. So, there is no way to install any version of [product_name] on Windows Server for multi-user access? Best wishes.
I am not certain in my case.

analysis.insight_summary: A user attempted to install [product_name] [version_no] on Windows Multipoint Server 2012, expecting clients to access the software, but found that it only worked on the server itself. Other participants explained that [product_name] [version_no] is licensed as a single-user application and does not support server-client or multi-user setups, resulting in unmet expectations for network deployment.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hoped to install and run [product_name] [version_no] in a way that multiple clients could access it in a server-client environment.
